milestone: Bounded simultaneous <=508 subgraph certification for exact Heule517 support
seed_rule: Restrict each of447 forced and383 killing colourings to H510, then extend every new vertex with an available colour; seven new vertices are mutually nonadjacent. Verify full resulting colouring and retain inclusion-minimal killing sets.
master: Omission variables y_v, one clause OR(not y_v) per certified killing set, exact at-least-nine omission encoding. SAT selection is enlarged monotonically to exactly508 vertices.
proof_branch: Any master or graph UNSAT report triggers one fresh Kissat proof-generating query, --seed=0 --conflicts=1000000 --time=180, then complete independent DRAT checking if UNSAT. Incomplete output is not evidence.
target_branch: A verified <=508 non-four-colourable graph additionally needs a checked proper five-colouring, full independent geometry and certificate audit.
stop: Stop on checked family closure, checked target, any UNKNOWN, or64 completed graph candidates; checkpoint and yield. No new point, quota, seed or proof phase.
